description: A clock multiplier with four independent rows, each turning one clock into a whole-number multiple of it

params.text: Makes every row fire on each clock beat even where that row's gate is closed, while leaving the faster subdivisions to the open rows alone; it is ignored while the BASE row's jack is patched
How many pulses this row puts out for each beat of the clock, a whole number from 1 to 8

inputs.text: Takes over the BASE switch while patched: at or above 1V every row fires on each clock beat whatever its own gate is doing, and below 1V only open rows do
The clock being multiplied; the interval between two rising edges above 1V is the tempo every output is worked out from
Runs this row while the voltage here is at or above 5V and stops it below that; with nothing patched the row runs

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse at this row's multiplied rate
A 1ms pulse at the first two rows' multipliers multiplied together, counting only rows whose gate is open
A 1ms pulse at the first three rows' multipliers multiplied together, counting only rows whose gate is open
A 1ms pulse at all four rows' multipliers multiplied together, counting only rows whose gate is open

notes: nothing comes out until a clock is patched to CLOCK and has ticked twice: the tempo is measured from the gap between two edges.
the multiplied beats stop once a whole clock interval has gone by with no new edge, so a clock that stops leaves the module silent rather than free-running.
